title: Run ledger contract
goal: A versioned, metadata-only run ledger keyed by case identity, written only from admitted reports
acceptance: Schema: per case pack id, pack version, case hash, model/profile/runtime/settings identity, machine scenario, report hash, date; no outputs or prompts
`gauntlet ledger record --report=… --ledger=…` admits the report first and refuses unadmitted, partial-identity or duplicate entries
Documented in docs with the identity fields that make evidence reusable
validation: Fixtures for admit, refuse and duplicate; npm test
escalation: A schema field that could carry private content is an owner decision

effort.basis: Released in v0.6.0 after PR #34 green CI 43020317739 and independent review; initial estimate retained in Git.

privacy: Metadata only: identities, hashes, dates; no outputs, prompts or credentials.
